Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
Letter of Recommendation
LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION
Our ref: 38
31/03/2026
This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work “Water Treatment
Plant — West Bengal Pkg-44” (Rs. 1783.00 Lakh), completed on 16/04/2016. On the basis of that
engagement we record the following:
Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site;
Responsiveness of the contractor's site management.
The contractor's planning, quality control and coordination with this office were of a good standard,
and the work was commissioned without outstanding defects.
Verification: Harish Iyer, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000.
